remarks.para: The .NET binding generator uses to run each corresponding blocking method on a thread-pool thread. These are not native asynchronous I/O operations, and the extension methods have no cancellation parameter. Task completion does not mean that buffered bytes have been flushed to the underlying stream. Await each task to observe completion or an exception from the blocking method.
